description: Test one named feature (e.g. login, checkout). mode:"execute" (default): a job that explores toward it, records pass/fail/blocked per case, and writes a report (poll qa_job_status). mode:"plan" (read-only): scope, cases, fixtures, plan. Without sessionId it bootstraps from projectRoot (consent-gated). Auth, paywall, or missing-fixture gates report blocked, not failed.

feature.description: The feature to test, in natural language.

mode.description: execute (default, job) | plan (read-only) | interactive (until the first question).

timeoutMs.description: Ignored (kept for compatibility): the run is bounded by maxScreens / maxActions; poll qa_job_status.

name: qa_test_feature
title: Test a feature (focused)
